source_note_markdown:
**Source located: parish index; original image uninspected.** The reviewed [Scotland’s People](https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/) Old Parish Registers births and baptisms result gives WILLIAM GLASGOW, indexed date 15/10/1660, Leith South, parish 692 / 2, reference 20 / 330, and parents/other ARCHBALD GLASGOW/AGNES WATSON FR633 (FR633); indexed gender M.

The 10 September 2026 review matched the existing child-record account by date, locality and recorded family. This is supporting provenance, not a new event or relationship. The combined collection does not identify the date as a birthday. Names alone do not identify attached adult profiles or connect this child to a later adult. [Read the reviewed births and baptisms collection](/branches/scottish-families/#opr-births-to-1700). The complete earlier finding remains below under Archive and tools.
